storySection.title: A Luxury Print Story
paragraphs: Kohler has long represented classic design, craftsmanship, and luxury. With the introduction of its high-end Vibrant collection of faucets and vessels, the brand required more than a traditional product catalog. They desired a print ad piece that would allow them to convey the haptic beauty of their products in a manner that couldn’t be delivered on screens.

The aim was to develop a print marketing medium that would be greater than a brochure — something that raises the products, speaks luxury, and aids their sales teams both in showrooms and B2B presentations. Time was short, quality expectations were astronomical, and accuracy was not an option. This is where Prakria stepped in.

challenge.title: The Challage
challenge.description: Kohler wanted images that reflected the luxury and accuracy of their bathroom and kitchen products, but the pacing of traditional photography and standard design methods proved too slow.

list.text: The premium nature of the brand’s products requires that they be portrayed with extremely high quality visuals, where every angle, every shadow and every detail communicates a sense of craftsmanship, and luxury.
Conventional product photography was getting too time-consuming, expensive and logistically complicated, and not scalable for the diverse product range globally.
Kohler needed a partner who could deliver hyper-realistic 3D and CGI renderings matching luxury expectations,  while also meeting tight launch timelines.
The visual elements needed to be flexible enough to be used globally and had to support the message that Kohler is a provider of experiences, and not just appliances.

challenge.conclusionLine: In essence, the challenge involved capturing the essence of Kohler’s high-end products and translating that into clean, crisp digital images that could do justice to the physical luxury products and bridge the gap between reality and virtual reality.

startageySection.title: THE STRATEGY
startageySection.description:
For the Vibrant line, we began by making hyper-realistic 3D renderings of every product.

The Strategy

The goal was to make the Vibrant line feel truly tangible, not just seen, but felt. We achieved this by crafting hyper-realistic 3D renderings of every product, transforming visuals into detailed, immersive narratives.

list.title: Creative Concept
list.description: Each reflection, curve, and metallic highlight was rendered with precision, creating imagery so lifelike it conveyed texture, depth, and emotion.

list.title: Design Execution
list.description: These visuals became the foundation of the Vibrant Brochure, a creative print piece that blended 3D imagery, elegant layouts, and refined typography to tell a story of craftsmanship and innovation.

list.title: Outcome
list.description: The brochure elevated the brand presentation, proving that design realism can replace photography while delivering a more controlled, premium visual experience.

list.title: Print Advertisement Design
list.description: Each spread was crafted to highlight hero products with generous white space, sharp detail shots, and editorial-style layouts. The intention was to let the products “breathe,” much like a luxury fashion catalog.

list.title: Print Media Design
list.description: Our finishes and textures were quite deliberate: matte papers paired with glossy spot finishes to contrast with and reinforce the metallic vibrancy of the ranging products. This really, truly transformed the brochure into a tactile experience.

list.title: Print Media Advertising Strategy
list.description: The brochure wasn't just typical hand-out material. It was designed as a story tool for various B2B meetings, showroom displays, and client interactions of a very high-touch nature. It was more luxury brand literature than run-of-the-mill marketing collateral.

list.title: Advertising Printing Services
list.description: Partnering with specialized printing companies, we ensured that every page carried the intended depth and precision. Finishes were tested and approved meticulously to match Kohler’s global quality benchmarks.

list.title: Print and Media Advertising Integration
list.description: While the brochure was the centerpiece, the assets were extended into supporting print campaigns, showroom posters, and media inserts, creating a consistent story across platforms.

resultSection.title: The RESULT
resultSection.description: The Vibrant Brochure proved that print advertising is far from obsolete — when done with precision and creativity, it becomes one of the most powerful storytelling tools available.

list.text: Sales teams reported improved engagement during presentations, prospects lingered on pages, touched the finishes, and treated the brochure more like a coffee table book than a leaflet.
Retailers appreciated the premium print media designs, noting how well the brochure complemented Kohler’s showroom experience.
Customers perceived the brand as even more luxurious, thanks to the brochure’s tactile storytelling.
The entire piece became a benchmark for creative print advertisement work in the luxury interiors segment.

whySection.title: WHY THIS MATTERS
whySection.description: In a digital-first world, print advertisement design still plays a unique role, especially for premium products where touch, texture, and physicality matter.Print media advertising allows brands like Kohler to control the experience in a way screens can’t.

list.text: Advertising printing services and printing agencies are crucial partners in turning concepts into masterpieces.
Print and media advertising works best when it blends strategy, storytelling, and material craft,  not just when it delivers specs to a printer.

whySection.conclusionLine: Prakria’s work on the Kohler Vibrant Brochure demonstrates how high-end printing services, precise design, and strategic thinking can turn a simple brochure into a memorable brand asset.

storySection.title: A Brand Affection Story
paragraphs: Nestlé Nido, particularly in its Ghana business, desired to go deeper with its primary consumer group, mothers of children between 0–12 years old. They had trust on the product level already, but they wanted to be viewed as more than a formula company, they wanted to be regarded as caring, friendly, and part of everyday life.

To do that, Nido decided to introduce merchandise for special occasions, “Back to School” and Ramadan, so the brand would appear in more meaningful, tangible ways in everyday routines. Their ask was: how do you design merchandise that resonates with kids and moms, is faithful to brand identity, and works across contexts?
This is where Prakria, acting like a full-spectrum branding agency and creative design studio, became the partner for turning brand values into real, loved objects.

challenge.title: THE CHALLENGE
challenge.description: As a beloved children’s milk brand in Ghana, NIDO wanted to deepen its connection with young families and become a visible part of their everyday lives, not just in the pantry.

list.text: NIDO needed to create merchandise for special occasions (e.g., Back to School & Ramadan) that felt fun, engaging and relevant for kids aged 0-12, while aligning with the brand’s identity.
The brand had to ensure the merchandise was approachable and friendly (to resonate with moms) yet cool and vibrant (to appeal to kids).
The task required a deep understanding of the Ghana market: local routines, kids’ preferences, cultural context, something that hadn’t been fully leveraged previously.
The merchandise needed to be both meaningful and collectible, not just a promotional item, but something kids would love and keep.

challenge.conclusionLine: In short, the challenge was to transform NIDO from a trusted milk powder brand into a visible lifestyle companion for kids and mothers, through merchandise that bridged brand familiarity with youthful energy.

startageySection.title: THE STRATEGY
startageySection.description: Our approach combined deep consumer understanding, context-sensitive theming, distinctive visual language, and a systematic product rollout to make Nido's merchandise loved and memorable.

list.title: Deep Dive on Consumer Insight
list.description: We started by understanding a mother’s day-to-day with her child, from morning routines to bedtime, school prep, religious observances, and playtime. We mapped items they commonly use or see (stationery, clothing, school bags, small gifts). These insights became the playground for ideation.

list.title: Occasions & Themes
list.description: We focused on Back to School and Ramadan, two occasions with strong emotional linkage in Ghana. For each, we designed a set of merchandise that would feel useful, celebratory, and brand-relevant.

list.title: Visual Style: Doodles, Brand Heart & Colors
list.description: To keep it youthful and engaging, we adopted a doodle style in design. At the same time, we retained the iconic Nido “heart” motif and brand color palette to maintain strong recall. This balance of creativity and brand faithfulness is what top branding companies do best.

list.title: Merchandise Forms & Catalog
list.description: We created a full catalogue of merchandise (bags, t-shirts, stationery, gift items) for the events, each carrying consistent visual language and brand markers. The collection was rendered in 3D mockups so the client (and later the market) could see how every item would turn out in real life.

list.title: Brand Communication & Strategy
list.description: Each merchandise item was given a micro narrative, like “carry love to school” or “celebrate with joy,” tying back to Nido’s positioning as a caring, close companion for families.

list.alt: Print Media Advertising / Merchandise Promotion icon
list.title: Print Media Advertising / Merchandise Promotion
list.description: To launch these lines, we designed supporting print media such as posters, flyers, and school handouts to announce the merchandise, build excitement, and visually connect them with Nido’s packaging and brand identity.

list.title: Creative Print Advertisement
list.description: Print materials were integrated from the start, not as an afterthought—flyers and posters used the same doodle elements, brand colors, and heart motif, ensuring the merchandise and print advertising told one consistent story.

list.title: Printing Services Coordination
list.description: We collaborated closely with boutique printing companies to guarantee that paper color, texture, and finish matched the vibrancy and quality seen in our 3D models and merchandise concepts.

list.alt: Print and Media Advertising Integration icon
list.title: Print and Media Advertising Integration
list.description: The product line was promoted through both physical print touchpoints—retail signage, school posters—and digital notices, making the campaign truly omnichannel.

resultSection.title: The RESULT
resultSection.description: The catalog of merchandise was well received by both moms and kids, the playful doodle style, useful items, and emotional tie to Nido made it feel more than a promo.

list.text: The Nido heart and colors ensured parents could instantly trace the products to the brand, reinforcing brand identity through merchandise.
The print media advertising built anticipation and visibility, schools and local stores used posters and flyers to draw attention.
The campaign gave Nido more than merchandise, it gave the brand relevance in everyday life beyond nutrition.
For Prakria, this project demonstrated how creative design agency thinking plus brand strategy can transform merchandise into brand equity.

whySection.title: WHY THIS MATTERS
whySection.description: Merchandise is often treated as a side effort or giveaway. But here, brand building companies can see how thoughtfully designed merchandise can become another medium of brand expression.

list.text: It shows that branding consultants must reach beyond identity and design into real consumer lives.
Print media advertising and promotional print collateral aren’t separate silos, they must align deeply with brand visuals.
Branding consultants must reach beyond identity and design into real consumer lives.
When printing services are integrated early, the final quality lives up to design ambition.
Combining creative print advertisement, merchandise, and brand strategy helps a brand move from transactional to relational.

whySection.conclusionLine: Prakria’s collaboration with Nido demonstrates how creative design and brand strategy can transform merchandise into lasting brand equity.

storySection.title: A Bold Refresh Story
paragraphs: Polo Extra Strong has always stood out for its intense flavor and strong personality. But the brand needed a sharper, fresher focus — one that visually conveyed the ‘Extra Strong’ energy across print communications, packaging, and in-store touchpoints.

The new campaign required a key visual that could seamlessly extend across print media advertising, outdoor billboards, in-store displays, and promotional material. It needed to be dynamic, gritty, and unmistakably Polo — while staying true to the brand’s legacy of boldness and clarity.
To achieve this, Polo sought more than a designer — they needed a creative design partner who understood both concept and execution. That’s where Prakria stepped in.

challenge.title: The Challage
challenge.description: Polo Extra Strong had to deliver the brand’s punch-and-refresh positioning in a fiercely competitive, flavour-led mint market.

list.text: The mint category was crowded with strong flavour variants, making it difficult for Polo Extra Strong to differentiate based purely on something “extra strong”.
The brand had to enhance the perception of strength and refreshment without compromising the playful, approachable ethos of Polo (the “mint with the hole”).
Packaging and communication needed to signal bold flavour clearly and instantly, across both retail shelves and digital thumbnails.
The challenge was to strike a balance between high impact messaging (strong mint) and brand continuity to ensure that the Polo identity was still recognisable and consistent.

challenge.conclusionLine: In short, the challenge was to differentiate Polo Extra Strong as both powerfully strong and refreshingly Polo by ramping up the intensity whilst maintaining the familiar brand warmth.

startageySection.title: THE STRATEGY
startageySection.description: We began by exploring what “Extra Strong” truly feels like  not just a flavor, but a burst of intensity. That idea became the creative anchor for the entire design system.

list.title: Creative Concept
list.description: The centerpiece was a bold, slashing “X” from the word Extra, slicing through the visuals to express strength, speed, and power. It became the brand’s unmistakable symbol of energy.

list.title: Design Execution
list.description: Around this, we built a visual language of motion lines, textured backdrops, and high-contrast compositions that radiated dynamism and impact.

list.title: Outcome
list.description: The result was a flexible, scalable identity system, instantly recognizable as “Extra Strong” across packaging, print, and retail, a brand that visually hums with energy.

startageySection.conclusionLine: Bringing It All Together: Print & Media Advertising Once the key visual was finalised, we rolled it out across a full print and media advertising toolkit

executionSection.title: THE CREATIVE EXECUTION
executionSection.description:
Because print advertisement design was central to this project, we paid close attention to how the visual would perform on different surfaces. A key visual might look great on a laptop screen, but print is a different world.

We tested the design across small magazine formats, large outdoor billboards, and in-store panels. We adjusted typography, textures, and colour layers so that the final artwork would retain its boldness even at a distance or under different lighting.

We also worked hand in hand with trusted printing companies, providing precise colour separations, bleed settings, and finish specifications to make production seamless. This is where our experience as a printing agency really comes through, we don’t hand over files and hope for the best; we guide the entire print journey.

list.title: Posters & Billboards
list.description: Striking 'X' motifs provided instant outdoor visibility and made the campaign unmissable at street and highway scale.

list.title: Retail Display & Shelf Talkers
list.description: Custom-designed panels and shelf talkers created an energetic presence at the point of sale, unifying the brand story on every aisle.

list.title: Magazine & Flyer Advertising
list.description: Dynamic print advertisement layouts were deployed across magazines and flyers to maintain the high-impact, bold aesthetic in editorial formats.

list.title: Technical Print-Ready Files
list.description: Production-ready files—color separations, finish specs, and print formats—were tailored to each vendor for seamless execution and consistent brand results.

resultSection.title: THE RESULT
resultSection.description: The new key visual gave Polo Extra Strong a fresh, attention-grabbing identity that worked beautifully in print media advertising and retail spaces.

list.text: Retailers noticed stronger shelf presence and improved recall.
Outdoor placements stopped traffic, thanks to the crisp, punchy visuals.
Because both the design and advertising print services were aligned from the beginning, the end products came out crisp, colorful, and just as planned.
It showed that by using the correct method, print advertising can still pack a punch.

whySection.title: WHY THIS MATTERS
whySection.description: This project is a reminder that good branding doesn't stop at the computer screen. When design and print are hand in hand, the results are tangible, memorable, and powerful.Print media designs are strongest when they’re created with real materials and finishes in mind.

list.text: Working closely with printing services ensures fidelity and consistency across every execution.
A strong print advertisement design can unify a campaign across media, from retail to outdoor to editorial.
And above all, thoughtful print and media advertising can give a classic brand like Polo a fresh, modern punch.

storySection.title: A Visual Story That Redefined Speed and Flavor
paragraphs: When Nestlé was preparing to introduce the new Grekyo Blueberry Yogurt flavor, the objective was clear: move fast, delight consumers, and make the product instantly recognizable on the shelf.
This refreshing, foreign-inspired flavor required a standout visual that could evoke indulgence, freshness, and the luxurious texture of blueberries at first glance.

But time was a challenge. Traditional studio product shoots were slow and costly — the team needed a faster solution that looked every bit as good as a full-scale shoot. That’s when Nestlé turned to Prakria to bring the idea to life.

challenge.title: THE CHALLENGE
challenge.description: The launch of NESTLÉ Grekyo Blueberry yogurt flavor by the brand was an attempt to grab attention in a fast way with a strong visual language that matched the premium and exotic feel of the product.

list.text: The idea was to highlight the exotic and premium taste of the new Greek yogurt flavor and get it to the market quickly before competitors could react.
A traditional photoshoot posed time, cost and complexity constraints, making it difficult to meet the fast-turnaround requirement.
The key visual needed to be high impact and mouth-watering, not just a product shot, but something that conveyed flavour, texture and desirability instantly.
In short, the challenge was to create a standout, premium visual identity for Grekyo’s new blueberry flavour fast, cost-effectively and with maximum impact.

startageySection.title: THE STRATEGY
startageySection.description: We set out to combine speed and craft  delivering high-impact visuals without the delays of traditional photo shoots.

list.title: Creative Concept
list.description: Instead of photography, we built the entire scene in 3D and CGI, crafting a hyper-real blueberry explosion that captured the indulgence of Greek yogurt and exotic fruit in perfect harmony.

list.title: Design Execution
list.description: Every swirl, droplet, and berry was precisely rendered to feel luscious, creamy, and alive. Full digital control meant we could easily generate multiple visual variations for print, packaging, and retail, all without a physical setup.

list.title: Outcome
list.description: A visual masterpiece that married speed with precision,  enabling stunning, adaptable brand communication at record pace.

executionSection.title: THE CREATIVE EXECUTION
executionSection.description: Bringing It to Life Through Print & Media Advertising Once the key visual was approved, we extended it into a full suite of print and media advertising assets. This included:

list.title: Posters & Retail Panels for POS
list.description: Posters and retail panels for point-of-sale displays.

list.title: Magazine & Flyer Layouts
list.description: Magazine and flyer layouts created as creative print advertisements, ensuring the indulgent blueberry visuals took center stage.

list.title: Print Media Designs for All Formats
list.description: Print media designs tailored for various formats from large outdoor billboards to compact shelf-talkers, ensuring the image quality and impact remained consistent.

list.title: Advertising Printing Services
list.description: Coordination with advertising printing services to ensure vibrant color reproduction and perfect material finishes.

executionSection.subDescription: Our team also worked closely with partner printing agencies to validate proofs and maintain quality across different printing processes. This ensured that what consumers saw in-store matched the stunning digital renders exactly.

resultSection.title: The RESULT
resultSection.description: The Nestlé Grekyo Blueberry Yogurt launch made a splash, quite literally. The bold, indulgent visual caught consumer attention immediately, whether they saw it on a billboard, in a store, or in a magazine.

list.text: The print media advertising assets stood out in crowded retail spaces, helping the new flavor gain quick visibility.
The campaign maintained consistent quality across all printed materials thanks to careful collaboration with printing services and printing companies.
The creative print advertisement visuals allowed Nestlé to communicate freshness and indulgence without lengthy production timelines.
Most importantly, the brand achieved speed to market,  staying ahead of the competition while maintaining the premium image of the Grekyo brand.

whySection.title: WHY THIS MATTERS
whySection.description: This project demonstrates that contemporary branding is all about flexibility as well as imagination. By combining sophisticated CGI, considered design, and high-end production, brands can generate campaign images that are breathtaking as well as print-ready across platforms.

list.text: Print ad design need not depend on conventional shoots, judicious application of technology can provide the same emotional impact quicker.
Early convergence of print advertising imagination guarantees what appears fabulous on a screen looks stunning on physical touchpoints.
Collaborating with a printing agency capable of grasping creative intent guarantees final execution is flawless.
